Let’s find out.\u003c/p\u003e","pageType":"NonCollapsible","sectionScore":7.5},{"pageId":134097,"priority":4,"pageName":"Engine and Performance","content":"\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cimg src=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/0x0/statics/grey.gif\u0027 alt=\u0027Engine Shot\u0027 title=\u0027Maruti Suzuki Brezza Engine Shot\u0027 data-original=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/642x361/n/cw/ec/125713/maruti-suzuki-brezza-engine-shot34.jpeg?isig=0\u0026amp;wm=1\u0026q=75\u0027 class=\u0027lazy\u0027\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003eAt the heart of the new Maruti Suzuki Brezza is a 1.5-litre, four-cylinder, K15C, naturally aspirated petrol engine that produces a maximum power output of 102bhp and 136.8Nm of torque. This engine is paired with a five-speed manual unit and a six-speed torque converter automatic unit. This review focuses on the manual variant, and you can watch our review of the automatic variant above. Puttering around the city is pretty easy with the Brezza, and this is what exactly Maruti has aimed for with respect to the tuning. In stop-and-go traffic, there are oodles of low-end torque on offer and at low to medium speeds, this engine is very tractable. It doesn\u0027t judder or feel like it\u0027s strained when close to idling RPM.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cimg src=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/0x0/statics/grey.gif\u0027 alt=\u0027Right Front Three Quarter\u0027 title=\u0027Maruti Suzuki Brezza Right Front Three Quarter\u0027 data-original=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/642x361/n/cw/ec/125713/maruti-suzuki-brezza-right-front-three-quarter6.jpeg?isig=0\u0026amp;wm=1\u0026amp;q=75\u0027 class=\u0027lazy\u0027\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003eOut on the highway, the car asks you to shift early in lieu of returning a higher fuel efficiency. Up-shifts are recommended by the system around the 2,000rpm mark via the gear-shift indicator on the MID. Out on the wide open roads the Brezza is happy to cruise at speeds of 100kmph, but you would need to down shift for overtakes. The NVH seems to be pretty good when the engine is relaxed, it’s only when you start pushing the car that the engine noise filters into the cabin at 3,500rpm, which isn’t exactly intrusive if you like the sound of an internal combustion engine.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cimg src=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/0x0/statics/grey.gif\u0027 alt=\u0027Right Rear Three Quarter\u0027 title=\u0027Maruti Suzuki Brezza Right Rear Three Quarter\u0027 data-original=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/642x361/n/cw/ec/125713/maruti-suzuki-brezza-right-rear-three-quarter9.jpeg?isig=0\u0026amp;wm=1\u0026amp;q=75\u0027 class=\u0027lazy\u0027\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003eHill-hold assist, commonly known as hill hold control, is now offered as standard across the variant line-up of the Brezza. Over undulations and almost non-existent patches of tar and concrete that we call roads, the Brezza keeps its passengers in comfort on most occasions, with the rare chance that a pothole finds its way to unsettle the occupants of the car. Body movement isn’t quite evident either, and the car feels fairly planted even at triple-digit speeds.\u003c/p\u003e","pageType":"Collapsible","sectionScore":7.5},{"pageId":134101,"priority":6,"pageName":"Comfort, Convenience, and Features","content":"\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cimg src=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/0x0/statics/grey.gif\u0027 alt=\u0027Dashboard\u0027 title=\u0027Maruti Suzuki Brezza Dashboard\u0027 data-original=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/642x361/n/cw/ec/125713/maruti-suzuki-brezza-dashboard31.jpeg?isig=0\u0026amp;wm=1\u0026amp;q=75\u0027 class=\u0027lazy\u0027\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003eStep inside the Brezza and you are welcomed by a dual-tone upholstery theme of brown and black, which, apart from standing out in the sea of beige and black themes, gives the car a rather rich feel. The first thing that grabs one’s attention would be the new floating nine-inch SmartPlay Pro touchscreen infotainment system. Nestled on top of the new centre console, which by the way, borrows the design of the buttons from the new Baleno, the infotainment system is larger than the outgoing model by two inches. The overall quality of the interiors are on par for the segment, but the material and quality of plastics used around the AC vents could have been better.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cimg src=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/0x0/statics/grey.gif\u0027 alt=\u0027Head-Up Display (HUD)\u0027 title=\u0027Maruti Suzuki Brezza Head-Up Display (HUD)\u0027 data-original=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/642x361/n/cw/ec/125713/maruti-suzuki-brezza-head-up-display-hud-25.jpeg?isig=0\u0026amp;wm=1\u0026amp;q=75\u0027 class=\u0027lazy\u0027\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003eAnother welcome addition is the new flat-bottom steering wheel, and placed behind the revised instrument cluster is a Head-Up Display (HUD), which also made its debut in the new Baleno. On the other hand, what does make its debut on the Brezza when it comes to Maruti Suzuki’s entire line-up though, and is the party trick for a good number of folks out there, is an electric sunroof.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cimg src=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/0x0/statics/grey.gif\u0027 alt=\u0027Infotainment System\u0027 title=\u0027Maruti Suzuki Brezza Infotainment System\u0027 data-original=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/642x361/n/cw/ec/125713/maruti-suzuki-brezza-infotainment-system20.jpeg?isig=0\u0026amp;wm=1\u0026amp;q=75\u0027 class=\u0027lazy\u0027\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003eA few other notable features that add convenience for Brezza owners include a 360-degree camera, an auto-dimming IRVM, wireless charging, a cooled glove box, ambient lighting, cruise control, automatic climate control, OTA updates, and Suzuki Connect telematics. In terms of safety, ESP is standard across the variant line-up, while six airbags are limited to the top-spec ZXi Plus variant. A few other notable safety features include height-adjustable front seat belts, a rear view camera, a high-speed alert system, a seat-belt reminder system, a rear defogger, an impact-sensing door-unlock function, and an auto-dimming IRVM. A glaring omission in the SUV regarding features was the lack of ventilated seats, which was noticed in the sunny weather of Chennai that hosted us as we tested the car. We can imagine how much we’d miss this feature in the humid weather of Mumbai during peak summers.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cimg src=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/0x0/statics/grey.gif\u0027 alt=\u0027Second Row Seats\u0027 title=\u0027Maruti Suzuki Brezza Second Row Seats\u0027 data-original=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/642x361/n/cw/ec/125713/maruti-suzuki-brezza-second-row-seats22.jpeg?isig=0\u0026amp;wm=1\u0026amp;q=75\u0027 class=\u0027lazy\u0027\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003eComing to the utility, there are bottle holders on every door as well as the centre console, and all of them can hold a one-litre bottle each. There is also a front arm-rest with storage function, but don’t expect the latter to hold much excluding small knick-knacks like a wallet and a medium-sized smartphone. The second-row occupants get a separate set of AC vents behind the front arm-rest, which also houses two USB charging ports, where one is a Type-C slot. Neat addition there Maruti, and we really appreciate the thought behind this. Also on offer is a folding arm-rest with two cup-holders, should the rear occupants feel the need to indulge in a cuppa on the go.\u003c/p\u003e","pageType":"Collapsible","sectionScore":7.5},{"pageId":134107,"priority":7,"pageName":"Exterior Design","content":"\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cimg src=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/0x0/statics/grey.gif\u0027 alt=\u0027Front View\u0027 title=\u0027Maruti Suzuki Brezza Front View\u0027 data-original=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/642x361/n/cw/ec/125713/maruti-suzuki-brezza-front-view37.jpeg?isig=0\u0026amp;wm=1\u0026amp;q=75\u0027 class=\u0027lazy\u0027\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003eCompared to the outgoing model, the 2022 Maruti Brezza gets a new fascia, replete with new bumpers, grille, and headlamps. The new single slat grille, with its matte black finish and Y-shaped design on either side, makes the fascia rather chunky. The headlamps are entirely new, with dual L-shaped LED DRLs and LED projector headlights. Sitting further below on the bumper are new LED fog lights, while a faux skid plate with a silver finish sits right in between.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cimg src=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/0x0/statics/grey.gif\u0027 alt=\u0027Right Side View\u0027 title=\u0027Maruti Suzuki Brezza Right Side View\u0027 data-original=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/642x361/n/cw/ec/125713/maruti-suzuki-brezza-right-side-view11.jpeg?isig=0\u0026amp;wm=1\u0026q=75\u0027 class=\u0027lazy\u0027\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003eThe side profile of the Brezza boasts of squared wheel arches that house the 16-inch diamond-cut alloy wheels. The ORVMs and roof get a gloss black finish, as do the A, B, and C-pillars, thus lending the SUV a floating roof design. The new shoulder line is definitely attention-grabbing and gives the Brezza a more muscular feel than the previous iteration.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cimg src=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/0x0/statics/grey.gif\u0027 alt=\u0027Rear View\u0027 title=\u0027Maruti Suzuki Brezza Rear View\u0027 data-original=\u0027https://imgd.aeplcdn.com/642x361/n/cw/ec/125713/maruti-suzuki-brezza-rear-view8.jpeg?isig=0\u0026amp;wm=1\u0026amp;q=75\u0027 class=\u0027lazy\u0027\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cp\u003eTowards the posterior, the model gets a new tail-gate with a stubby design on the corners and Brezza lettering positioned between the new two-piece wraparound LED tail lights. The new rear bumper with a silver skid plate and horizontally-mounted reflectors complete the rear profile. The redesigned front and rear profile are rather upright, and may or may not be to one’s taste. You could say it was more of the latter in my case.\u003c/p\u003e","pageType":"NonCollapsible","sectionScore":7.0},{"pageId":134111,"priority":8,"pageName":"Conclusion and Rivals","content":"\u003cp\u003eThe new Maruti Brezza then, has made a considerable amount of progress from the previous version that was on sale.
